title: acordarse (me acuerdo), clarifying with gustar: le gusta a ella

cards.title: acordarse = to remember
cards.body: 'I remember myself.' The o splits when stressed: me acuerdo. In the we form it doesn't: nos acordamos.

examples.en: I don't remember if I gave it to him or to her.
examples.es: No me acuerdo si se lo di a él o a ella.

examples.en: We don't remember if we gave it to him or to them.
examples.es: No nos acordamos si se lo dimos a él o a ellas.

cards.title: gustar: take the middle road
cards.body: Until gustar feels automatic, go through 'it is pleasing to him/her': le gusta (never 'la gusta').

cards.title: Clarify: le gusta a ella
cards.body: Le could be him, her or formal you; add a ella / a él. 'Ella le gusta' would mean SHE is pleasing to someone (someone likes her).

examples.es: Le gusta a ella. / A ella le gusta.

practice.why: No split in the we form.

practice.en: I don't remember if I gave it to him or to her.
es: No me acuerdo si se lo di a él o a ella
No me acuerdo de si se lo di a él o a ella
practice.why: se lo di + a él o a ella.

practice.en: We don't remember if we gave it to him or to them (women).
es: No nos acordamos si se lo dimos a él o a ellas
No nos acordamos de si se lo dimos a él o a ellas
